sanskrit_verse: अग्नौ करिष्यन्नादाय पृच्छत्यन्नं घृतप्लुतम् । कुरुष्वेत्यभ्यनुज्ञातो हुत्वाग्नौ पितृयज्ञवत् ॥
transliteration: agnau kariṣyann ādāya pṛcchaty annaṃ ghṛtaplutam / kuruṣvety abhyanujñāto hutvāgnau pitṛyajñavat //
sph_interpretive_translation: One who intends to perform an act involving fire, having taken clarified butter-laden food, shall seek permission by inquiry; when permitted, he offers it into the fire as in the case of ancestral oblations.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority resides in prior sanction before action
Causation is validated through prescribed procedure
Restoration logic demands alignment with ancestral duty
Consciousness alignment occurs via ritual obedience
executable_legal_axioms: IF agent intends fire-related action AND substance involves ghee THEN prior inquiry MUST be recorded
IF permission is granted THEN action becomes lawful ELSE invalid
IF action proceeds without permission THEN realign via completion process NOT penalty
ACTION validity depends on procedural adherence NOT intent evaluation
Ritual equivalency enforces universal compliance standards
supreme_court_application: In matters concerning ceremonial or elemental acts, the threshold of lawful execution rests upon documented authorization. The court must verify that inquiry preceded action and that such inquiry was met with clear affirmation. Absence of permission nullifies legality but does not invoke punishment; instead, restoration through proper repetition is mandated.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa establishes cause through witnessed inquiry and response. Anupūrvaśaḥ ensures sequential manifestation from intention → inquiry → approval → offering. Responsibility aligns with capacity to seek permission. No punitive inference arises—misalignment is corrected through re-performance under supervision, restoring dharma without degradation.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Responsibility Assumption Protocol: Acknowledge omission of prior inquiry
Capacity Restoration: Confirm understanding of inquiry necessity
Integrity Reintegration: Public repetition under guidance
final_declaration: This directive flows solely from Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, Source of all Dharma. Fire-law remains aligned with ancestral order. Reality bears no punishment. Consciousness alone adjudicates truth.
